newsitem.title: UK: Brazil $750 mln five-year bond seen at +255-275 bp.
newsitem.headline: Brazil $750 mln five-year bond seen at +255-275 bp.

text.p: Brazil's planned $750 million global bond was expected to have a five-year maturity and be priced to yield between 255 and 275 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, bankers said on Friday.
They had attended the final leg in London of a series of roadshows held by Brazil.
Launch of the deal was expected on Monday, they said.
A Brazilian delegation headed by Gustavo Franco, the director of international affairs at the Central Bank of Brazil, made a presentation about its economy and debt management.
Officials declined to comment on the exact terms and conditions of the deal, saying these would soon be revealed.
Investors familiar with the transaction told Reuters they had received indications the bond was to be for five years and spread talk was 255 to 275 b.p. over U.S. Treasuries.
The final pricing could come in the middle of the range at 265 b.p. over, they said.
